title: Solumbe attestation record, version 2
description: One line of a Solumbe ledger (JSON Lines): the verdict a merged commit shipped under, bound to the request, the declared scope, the exact tree and the record before it. recordHash = sha256(prevHash + canonical(record without recordHash and signature)), where canonical is JSON with object keys sorted and no whitespace. The signature, when present, is Ed25519 over the 32 bytes of recordHash.

mergeSha.description: The merged commit this record attests.

baseSha.description: The commit the merge was reviewed against.

pr.description: The pull request number, when the merge came from one.

attestedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the verdict was generated.

engineVersion.description: Review engine version that produced the verdict.

policy.description: Policy profile: standard, company or high-risk.

checks.description: Each gate check by name and status. Summaries and details are not recorded.

impactedFiles.description: P, live: the files ranked for the request when the verdict was produced.

request.description: R: the request the change was made under. Null when none was stated.

contract.description: P, declared: the scope contract the change was held against. Null when no intent was supplied.

tip.description: Hash of the declared intent as amended.

undeclared.description: Changed files that were never declared.

subject.description: T: the exact change the verdict was measured on. Null when the gate read a working tree.

treeSha.description: The Git tree object of the change.

changedPathsHash.description: D: sha256 of the canonical sorted list of changed paths. The diff itself is never recorded; with baseSha and treeSha it is recomputable from the repository.

convergence.description: Convergence score, when one was measured.

receipt.description: Inputs hash of the convergence receipt.

prevHash.description: recordHash of the record before this one, or 64 zeros for the first.

keyId.description: First 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the public key (SPKI, DER).

value.description: Signature over the bytes of recordHash, base64.
